name: Ruchira
reason: Sanskrit rucirā, charming; auspicious and correct.

name: Ruchika
reason: rucikā, from ruci (radiance, liking); widely used.

name: Shrutika
reason: śrutikā, derived from śruti; acceptable modern name.

name: Swarali
reason: Devanagari short-i ending disagrees with IAST ālī.

fix.meaning_en: A row or series of musical notes.

name: Vidula
reason: vidulā, a Mahabharata figure (mother of Sanjaya) and a wise woman; correct.

name: Aboli
reason: Marathi name of the crossandra flower; neutral and pleasant.

name: Bansari
reason: IAST vaṃśarī did not match Devanagari बांसुरी; aligned to bāṃsurī.

name: Binal
reason: Etymology cannot be supported; no Sanskrit basis for bīnala.

name: Baishakhi
reason: vaiśākhī, born in Vaishakha; iast and devanagari agree.

name: Joyeeta
reason: Bengali form of jayitā, victorious; consistent.

name: Nilanjana
reason: IAST and Devanagari disagreed on long vowels and conjunct.
